name: Garlic Butter Chicken
instructions: Melt butter in a pan over medium heat. Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute. Season chicken with salt and pepper, add to pan, cook 6-7 minutes per side. Garnish with parsley.

name: Mediterranean Pasta Salad
instructions: Boil salted water, cook pasta 10 minutes. Wash tomatoes, slice olives, tear basil. Combine tomatoes and basil with olive oil. Drain pasta, cool. Toss everything with mozzarella and tuna. Rest 30 minutes.

name: Simple Fried Rice
instructions: Heat oil in wok. Scramble eggs, remove. Add garlic, then rice. Stir-fry 3 minutes. Add soy sauce, eggs, green onions. Serve hot.

name: Tomato Basil Soup
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic in oil. Add chopped tomatoes and stock. Simmer 20 minutes. Blend until smooth. Stir in basil before serving.

name: Chicken Stir Fry
instructions: Slice chicken and vegetables. Heat oil in wok. Cook chicken until golden, remove. Stir-fry vegetables 3 minutes. Add ginger, garlic, soy sauce. Return chicken, toss, serve.

name: Cheesy Omelette
instructions: Whisk eggs with salt and pepper. Melt butter in a non-stick pan. Pour in eggs, cook until almost set. Add cheese, fold in half. Serve immediately.

name: Pancakes
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Whisk in milk and eggs. Melt butter in pan. Pour 1/4 cup batter per pancake. Cook until bubbles form, flip, cook 1 minute.

name: Beef Tacos
instructions: Brown beef with onion and garlic. Add cumin and paprika. Warm taco shells. Fill with beef, top with cheese and lettuce.

name: Spaghetti Bolognese
instructions: Brown beef with onion and garlic. Add canned tomatoes, simmer 30 minutes. Cook spaghetti al dente. Serve sauce over pasta, top with basil.

name: Chicken Caesar Salad
instructions: Grill chicken and slice. Toss lettuce with dressing. Add chicken, croutons, and parmesan. Serve immediately.

name: Vegetable Curry
instructions: Sauté onion, garlic, ginger. Add curry powder and vegetables. Pour coconut milk, simmer 20 minutes until tender. Serve with rice.

name: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
instructions: Butter bread on outside. Place cheese between slices. Grill in pan until golden on both sides, cheese melted.

name: Shakshuka
instructions: Sauté onion, pepper, garlic. Add tomatoes and spices, simmer 10 minutes. Make wells, crack eggs in. Cover and cook until whites are set.

name: Beef Stew
instructions: Brown beef in batches. Sauté onion and garlic. Add flour, stock, tomato paste. Simmer 90 minutes. Add vegetables, cook 30 more minutes.

name: Mushroom Risotto
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic. Add rice, toast 1 minute. Add wine, stir until absorbed. Add stock one ladle at a time, stirring. Stir in mushrooms, butter, parmesan.

name: Chicken Noodle Soup
instructions: Simmer chicken in stock 20 minutes. Remove and shred. Add vegetables, cook 10 minutes. Add noodles, cook 5 minutes. Return chicken, garnish with parsley.

name: Margherita Pizza
instructions: Mix flour, yeast, water, salt into dough. Rest 1 hour. Top with tomatoes, mozzarella. Bake 250C for 10 minutes. Add basil and olive oil.

name: Beef Burger
instructions: Form beef into patties, season. Grill 4 minutes per side. Toast buns. Assemble with cheese, lettuce, tomato, onion, ketchup.

name: Pad Thai
instructions: Soak noodles 20 minutes. Stir-fry shrimp, remove. Scramble eggs. Add noodles, soy sauce, shrimp. Toss with sprouts, peanuts, lime.

name: French Toast
instructions: Whisk eggs, milk, cinnamon, sugar. Dip bread in mixture. Melt butter in pan. Cook bread 2 minutes per side. Serve with syrup.

name: Caprese Salad
instructions: Slice mozzarella and tomatoes. Layer alternating on plate. Add basil leaves. Drizzle olive oil, season with salt and pepper.

name: Chicken Curry
instructions: Sauté onion, garlic, ginger. Add curry powder and chicken, brown. Add tomatoes, simmer 10 minutes. Add coconut milk, cook 15 minutes. Serve over rice.

name: Egg Fried Rice
instructions: Heat sesame oil in wok. Scramble eggs, remove. Add garlic, rice, vegetables. Stir-fry 3 minutes. Add soy sauce, eggs, green onions.

name: Greek Salad
instructions: Chop cucumber, tomatoes, onion. Combine with olives. Crumble feta on top. Drizzle olive oil, sprinkle oregano.

name: Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Boil peeled potatoes until tender, 20 minutes. Drain, mash. Add butter and milk, mash until smooth. Season with salt and pepper.

name: Chocolate Chip Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugars. Beat in eggs and vanilla. Mix in flour and baking soda. Fold in chips. Bake at 180C for 10-12 minutes.

name: Banana Bread
instructions: Mash bananas. Mix with melted butter, sugar, eggs, vanilla. Fold in dry ingredients. Pour into loaf pan, bake 180C for 55 minutes.

name: Tuna Pasta
instructions: Cook pasta. Sauté garlic and chili in oil. Add tomatoes, simmer 5 minutes. Add tuna and pasta, toss. Garnish with parsley.

name: Chicken Quesadilla
instructions: Cook diced chicken with cumin and vegetables. Place chicken and cheese on half a tortilla. Fold over. Grill in pan until golden on both sides.

name: Creamy Tomato Pasta
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic. Add tomatoes, simmer 15 minutes. Add cream and parmesan. Toss with cooked pasta and basil.

name: Overnight Oats
instructions: Combine oats, milk, yogurt, honey in jar. Refrigerate overnight. Top with banana and berries before serving.

name: Beef Stir Fry
instructions: Slice beef thin. Marinate in soy sauce 10 minutes. Stir-fry beef, remove. Stir-fry vegetables, add ginger and garlic. Return beef, serve over rice.

name: Hummus
instructions: Blend chickpeas, tahini, garlic, lemon juice. Add water to reach smooth texture. Drizzle olive oil, sprinkle cumin.

name: Fish and Chips
instructions: Cut potatoes into chips, fry 5 minutes, drain. Mix flour and beer into batter. Dip fish, fry until golden. Serve with chips.

name: Vegetable Soup
instructions: Sauté onion, carrot, celery, garlic. Add potatoes, tomatoes, stock, thyme. Simmer 30 minutes. Season and serve.

name: Chicken Wings
instructions: Marinate wings in soy, honey, garlic, ginger 30 minutes. Bake at 200C for 40 minutes, turning once. Sprinkle sesame seeds.

name: Egg Salad Sandwich
instructions: Boil eggs 10 minutes, cool, peel, chop. Mix with mayo, mustard, green onion, salt, pepper. Spread on bread, close sandwiches.

name: Lentil Soup
instructions: Sauté onion, carrot, celery, garlic. Add lentils, stock, cumin. Simmer 30 minutes until lentils tender. Blend partially for creamy texture.

name: Peanut Butter Cookies
instructions: Mix peanut butter, sugar, egg. Add flour, baking soda, vanilla. Roll into balls, press with fork. Bake 180C for 10 minutes.

name: Chicken Fajitas
instructions: Slice chicken and vegetables. Sauté chicken with spices. Add vegetables, cook 5 minutes. Squeeze lime. Serve in warm tortillas.

name: Vegetable Fried Rice
instructions: Heat sesame oil. Add garlic, rice, vegetables. Stir-fry 4 minutes. Add soy sauce. Garnish with green onions.

name: Meatballs
instructions: Mix beef, breadcrumbs, eggs, parmesan, garlic, parsley. Roll into balls. Brown in pan. Simmer in tomato sauce 20 minutes.

name: Avocado Toast
instructions: Toast bread. Mash avocado with lemon, salt, pepper. Spread on toast. Drizzle olive oil, sprinkle chili flakes.

name: Roasted Vegetables
instructions: Chop vegetables into chunks. Toss with olive oil, salt, pepper, thyme. Roast at 200C for 30 minutes, stirring halfway.

name: Chili con Carne
instructions: Brown beef with onion and garlic. Add spices. Add tomatoes and beans. Simmer 30 minutes. Serve with rice or bread.

name: Tuna Melt
instructions: Mix tuna with mayo and onion. Butter bread. Place tuna and cheese between slices. Grill until golden.

name: Chicken Enchiladas
instructions: Cook chicken with spices, shred. Roll in tortillas with cheese. Top with tomato sauce and cheese. Bake 180C for 20 minutes.

name: Garlic Bread
instructions: Mix softened butter with minced garlic and parsley. Slice bread, spread mixture. Bake 200C for 10 minutes until golden.

name: Chicken Alfredo
instructions: Cook fettuccine. Sauté chicken in butter, remove. Add garlic, cream, parmesan. Toss with pasta and chicken. Garnish with parsley.

name: Vegetable Omelette
instructions: Sauté vegetables in butter. Whisk eggs, pour over. Cook until set. Add cheese, fold. Serve hot.

name: Beef Burrito
instructions: Cook beef with cumin. Layer rice, beans, beef, cheese, salsa on tortilla. Roll tightly. Grill 2 minutes per side.

name: Cauliflower Soup
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic in butter. Add cauliflower and stock. Simmer 20 minutes. Blend, add cream and nutmeg.

name: Breakfast Burrito
instructions: Cook bacon and diced potatoes. Scramble eggs. Warm tortillas. Fill with eggs, bacon, potatoes, cheese, salsa. Roll and serve.

name: Baked Salmon
instructions: Place salmon on baking sheet. Drizzle oil, add garlic, lemon slices. Bake 200C for 15 minutes. Garnish with parsley.

name: Pesto Pasta
instructions: Blend basil, pine nuts, parmesan, garlic, oil into pesto. Cook pasta. Toss hot pasta with pesto. Serve with extra parmesan.

name: Chicken Soup
instructions: Place chicken in pot with water, stock, vegetables. Simmer 2 hours. Remove chicken, shred. Return to pot with herbs. Serve hot.

name: Veggie Burger
instructions: Mash beans with onion, garlic, breadcrumbs, cumin. Form patties. Pan-fry 4 minutes per side. Serve on buns with lettuce and tomato.

name: Shrimp Scampi
instructions: Cook linguine. Sauté garlic and chili in butter. Add shrimp, cook 2 minutes. Add wine, lemon juice. Toss with pasta, parsley.

name: Chocolate Brownies
instructions: Melt chocolate and butter. Whisk in sugar, eggs, vanilla. Fold in flour, cocoa, salt. Bake 180C for 25 minutes. Cool before cutting.

name: Stuffed Bell Peppers
instructions: Cook rice with onion, garlic, tomatoes. Mix with cheese and parsley. Fill peppers. Bake 180C for 30 minutes.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt and spices. Grill or pan-sear. Sauté onion, garlic, ginger. Add tomatoes and spices, simmer. Add cream and chicken. Serve with rice.

name: Beef Pho
instructions: Simmer stock with charred onion, ginger, spices 1 hour. Strain. Cook noodles. Thinly slice raw beef. Pour hot broth over beef. Top with basil and lime.

name: Ratatouille
instructions: Slice all vegetables thinly. Sauté onion and garlic. Layer vegetables in dish. Drizzle oil, sprinkle thyme. Bake 180C for 45 minutes.

name: Chicken Pot Pie
instructions: Cook chicken and vegetables. Make roux with butter and flour, add stock. Combine with chicken and vegetables. Top with pastry. Bake 200C for 30 minutes.

name: Eggplant Parmesan
instructions: Slice eggplant, salt, rest 30 minutes. Bread and fry. Layer with tomato sauce, cheeses, basil. Bake 180C for 30 minutes.

name: Coleslaw
instructions: Shred cabbage and carrot. Mix mayo, vinegar, sugar, salt, pepper. Toss with vegetables. Chill 30 minutes before serving.

name: Sloppy Joes
instructions: Brown beef with onion and pepper. Add tomatoes, ketchup, sugar, vinegar. Simmer 15 minutes. Serve on toasted buns.

name: Tiramisu
instructions: Whisk yolks with sugar, fold in mascarpone. Dip ladyfingers in coffee. Layer with cream mixture. Dust with cocoa. Chill 4 hours.

name: Pulled Pork
instructions: Rub pork with spices and sugar. Slow cook 8 hours. Shred with forks. Mix with bbq sauce. Serve on buns.

name: Gazpacho
instructions: Blend all ingredients until smooth. Chill 2 hours. Serve cold with a drizzle of olive oil.

name: Mac and Cheese
instructions: Cook pasta. Make roux with butter and flour, add milk. Stir in cheese and mustard. Combine with pasta. Top with breadcrumbs, bake 180C for 20 minutes.

name: Chicken Satay
instructions: Slice chicken, thread onto skewers. Grill 4 minutes per side. Simmer peanut butter, coconut milk, soy, curry, garlic for sauce. Serve with lime.

name: Ramen
instructions: Simmer stock with miso, garlic, ginger, soy. Cook noodles. Soft boil eggs, halve. Assemble bowls with noodles, broth, pork, eggs, onions.

name: Vegetable Lasagna
instructions: Grill sliced vegetables. Layer sheets, vegetables, tomato sauce, cheese. Repeat. Top with cheese. Bake 180C for 40 minutes.

name: Chicken Schnitzel
instructions: Pound chicken thin. Coat in flour, egg, breadcrumbs. Pan-fry in oil and butter 3 minutes per side. Serve with lemon and parsley.

name: Butter Chicken
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt and spices. Grill. Sauté garlic, ginger, tomatoes, butter. Blend smooth. Add cream and chicken. Serve with rice or naan.

name: Pasta Carbonara
instructions: Cook spaghetti. Fry bacon with garlic. Whisk eggs with parmesan and pepper. Toss hot pasta with bacon then egg mixture off heat. Serve immediately.

name: Stuffed Mushrooms
instructions: Remove mushroom stems, chop. Mix with breadcrumbs, cheese, garlic, parsley. Fill caps. Bake 180C for 20 minutes.

name: Beef Stroganoff
instructions: Brown beef strips. Sauté onion and mushrooms. Add flour, stock, mustard. Return beef, add sour cream. Serve over egg noodles.

name: Chicken Parmesan
instructions: Bread chicken and fry. Top with tomato sauce, mozzarella, parmesan. Bake 180C for 20 minutes. Garnish with basil.

name: Pumpkin Soup
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic in butter. Add pumpkin and stock. Simmer 25 minutes. Blend, add cream, season with nutmeg.

name: Sweet and Sour Chicken
instructions: Fry chicken until golden. Sauté peppers and pineapple. Add ketchup, vinegar, sugar, soy. Simmer 5 minutes. Return chicken. Serve over rice.

name: Bruschetta
instructions: Toast bread. Rub with raw garlic. Top with diced tomatoes and basil. Drizzle oil and balsamic.

name: Vegetable Spring Rolls
instructions: Stir-fry shredded vegetables with ginger, garlic, soy. Cool. Roll in wrappers. Deep fry until golden. Serve with dipping sauce.

name: Chicken Shawarma
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt and spices 2 hours. Grill, slice. Serve in pita with tomatoes and garlic sauce.

name: Sushi Rolls
instructions: Cook rice, season with vinegar and sugar. Place nori on mat, spread rice. Add fillings. Roll tightly, slice. Serve with soy sauce.

name: Beef Wellington
instructions: Sear beef, brush with mustard. Pulse mushrooms into duxelles. Wrap beef in prosciutto and mushrooms. Wrap in pastry, brush with egg. Bake 200C for 25 minutes.

name: Falafel
instructions: Blend soaked chickpeas, onion, garlic, herbs, spices. Add flour. Form balls. Deep fry until golden. Serve in pita with tahini.

name: Chicken Biryani
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt and spices. Fry onions until crisp. Layer rice and chicken. Add saffron milk. Cook covered on low 30 minutes.

name: Beef Enchiladas
instructions: Brown beef with onion, garlic, cumin. Roll in tortillas with cheese. Place in dish, top with sauce and cheese. Bake 180C for 20 minutes. Top with cilantro.

name: Garlic Shrimp
instructions: Heat oil with garlic and chili. Add shrimp, cook 2 minutes per side. Add parsley and lemon. Serve with crusty bread.

name: Cheesecake
instructions: Crush crackers, mix with butter, press into pan. Beat cream cheese, sugar, eggs, vanilla, lemon. Pour over crust. Bake 160C for 50 minutes. Chill overnight.

name: Vegetable Pad See Ew
instructions: Soak noodles. Stir-fry garlic and vegetables. Add eggs, scramble. Add noodles and sauces. Toss well. Serve hot.

name: Pork Dumplings
instructions: Mix pork, cabbage, garlic, ginger, soy, sesame, onion. Fill wrappers, seal. Steam 8 minutes or pan-fry. Serve with dipping sauce.

name: Chicken Gyros
instructions: Marinate chicken in lemon, oregano, garlic. Grill and slice. Mix yogurt with cucumber and garlic for tzatziki. Serve in pita with tomatoes.

name: Beef Chili
instructions: Brown beef. Sauté onion, pepper, garlic. Add spices, tomatoes, beans. Simmer 45 minutes. Serve with rice, cheese, sour cream.

name: Veggie Pizza
instructions: Roll dough. Spread sauce, add cheese and vegetables. Sprinkle oregano. Bake 250C for 12 minutes.

name: Chicken Pot Stickers
instructions: Mix filling. Fill wrappers, fold and seal. Pan-fry, add water, cover, steam 6 minutes. Serve with dipping sauce.

name: Eggs Benedict
instructions: Poach eggs in vinegared water. Toast muffins. Warm ham. Whisk egg yolks with melted butter and lemon for hollandaise. Assemble and top with chives.

name: Lemon Garlic Chicken
instructions: Marinate chicken with lemon, garlic, oil, oregano. Arrange with sliced potatoes in baking dish. Roast 200C for 40 minutes. Garnish with parsley.

name: Bobotie
instructions: Soak bread in half the milk. Sauté onion and garlic, add beef and spices. Stir in soaked bread, jam, vinegar, almonds. Transfer to dish, top with beaten eggs and remaining milk. Add bay leaves. Bake at 180°C for 40 minutes until golden.

name: Chakalaka
instructions: Sauté onion in oil until soft. Add ginger, garlic, curry powder. Add cabbage, peppers, carrots, tomatoes. Cook 6-8 minutes. Add baked beans and simmer 10 minutes. Season and serve with pap or braai meat.

name: Malva Pudding
instructions: Mix flour and soda. Beat egg, sugar, jam, vanilla. Add buttermilk and melted butter. Fold in flour. Add vinegar. Bake at 180°C for 35-40 minutes. For sauce, heat milk, cream, butter, sugar and pour over hot pudding.

name: Peppermint Crisp Tart
instructions: Whip cream until stiff. Fold in caramel. Layer biscuits and cream mixture in dish. Repeat layers. Crush peppermint crisp over top. Refrigerate 4 hours or overnight.

name: Boerewors
instructions: Mince meats. Mix with spices, vinegar, worcestershire. Stuff into sausage casings. Braai over medium coals until cooked through, turning regularly.

name: Braaibroodjie
instructions: Butter bread on outside. Spread chutney on inside. Layer cheese, tomato, onion. Season. Close sandwich. Braai over medium coals until golden and cheese melted.

name: Pumpkin Fritters
instructions: Grate raw pumpkin. Mix with flour, sugar, baking powder, egg, cinnamon, salt. Drop spoonfuls into hot oil. Fry until golden. Drain. Dust with cinnamon sugar.

name: Buttermilk Rusks
instructions: Mix dry ingredients. Rub in butter. Add buttermilk, eggs, vanilla. Form dough. Shape into balls, place in pan. Bake at 180°C for 45 minutes. Break apart, dry in oven at 100°C for 4-5 hours.

name: Peri-Peri Chicken Livers
instructions: Sauté garlic in butter. Add livers, cook until browned. Add peri-peri sauce, lemon juice, cream. Simmer 5 minutes. Serve on crusty bread.

name: Tomato Bredie
instructions: Brown lamb. Sauté onions with spices. Return meat, add tomatoes, simmer 30 minutes. Add potatoes, cook 40-60 minutes until tender. Garnish with fresh herbs.

name: Chutney Chicken
instructions: Place sliced onions and chicken in oven dish. Mix yoghurt, cornflour, chutney, tea. Pour over chicken. Bake at 180°C for 30-45 minutes until golden and cooked through.

name: Mielie Bread
instructions: Mix all ingredients until smooth. Pour into greased loaf tin. Bake at 180°C for 35-40 minutes until golden. Serve warm with butter.

name: Creamy Potato Salad
instructions: Boil potatoes until tender, cool and halve. Boil eggs, chop. Mix mayonnaise, mustard, parsley, salt, pepper. Fold in potatoes and eggs. Refrigerate 1 hour.

name: Three-Bean Salad
instructions: Drain beans. Mix with chopped onion. Whisk vinegar, sugar, oil, mustard. Pour over beans. Refrigerate 4 hours or overnight.

name: Melkkos
instructions: Heat milk. Mix flour with a little cold milk to form paste. Stir into hot milk. Add butter and salt. Simmer until thickened. Serve with cinnamon sugar.

name: Mogodu
instructions: Clean and boil tripe until tender, 2-3 hours. Sauté onion and garlic. Add spices and tomatoes. Add tripe and stock. Simmer 30 minutes. Serve with pap.

name: Chicken Feet Stew
instructions: Clean chicken feet, boil until tender. Sauté onion, garlic, ginger. Add spices, tomatoes, stock. Add feet, simmer 20 minutes. Serve with pap or bread.

name: Oxtail Stew
instructions: Brown oxtail. Sauté vegetables. Add wine, stock, tomatoes, thyme. Return oxtail. Simmer 3 hours until tender. Serve with rice or mash.

name: Cape Malay Lamb Breyani
instructions: Marinate lamb in yoghurt and spices. Layer rice, lamb, potatoes, lentils. Add saffron water. Cook covered on low for 1 hour. Serve with sambals.

name: Mevrou
instructions: Brown beef. Sauté onion, garlic, ginger with spices. Add tomatoes and stock. Simmer 1 hour. Add potatoes, cook 30 minutes. Serve with rice.

name: Chana Masala (Chickpea Curry)
instructions: Sauté onion, garlic, and ginger until soft. Stir in spices, tomatoes, and rinsed chickpeas. Simmer for 15 minutes. Serve hot over cooked rice.

name: Koeksisters
instructions: Boil sugar, water, spices, lemon juice for syrup and chill. Make dough with flour, baking powder, butter, milk. Braid dough strips, deep fry until golden, submerge immediately into ice-cold syrup.

name: Vetkoek with Curry Mince
instructions: Knead dough, let rise 1 hour. Fry spoonfuls in hot oil until puffed and golden. Sauté mince, onion, garlic, spices, carrots, peas. Slice vetkoek open and stuff with hot mince.

name: Bean & Potato Bunny Chow
instructions: Cook spicy bean and potato curry with onions, garlic, ginger, spices, and tomatoes. Hollow out half bread loaves. Ladle hot curry into bread bowl and top with scooped bread.

name: Sausage & Potato Bake
instructions: Chop sausages, potatoes, onion, and bell pepper. Toss with oil, paprika, salt, and pepper. Bake at 200°C for 35 minutes until golden and crispy.

name: Melktert (Milk Tart)
instructions: Line pie dish with pastry. Heat milk with butter. Whisk eggs, sugar, cornflour, flour. Stir into hot milk until thick custard forms. Pour into crust, bake at 180°C for 25 minutes. Dust with cinnamon.

name: Creamy Garlic Spinach Pasta
instructions: Boil pasta. Sauté garlic in butter, add flour, then pour in milk to make sauce. Stir in spinach and cheese until melted. Toss with hot pasta.

name: Chicken Drumstick Sosaties
instructions: Simmer onion, curry, garlic, vinegar, and jam for marinade. Marinate drumsticks for 2 hours. Bake or braai over medium coals until cooked through and golden.

name: Pasta Aglio e Olio
instructions: Cook pasta in salted water. Sauté thinly sliced garlic and chili flakes gently in olive oil. Toss cooked pasta directly into the garlic oil with chopped parsley.

name: Dal Tadka (Yellow Lentil Curry)
instructions: Boil lentils until soft. Sauté onion, garlic, ginger, cumin, turmeric, and tomatoes in oil. Stir fried spice mixture into soft cooked lentils. Serve over rice.

name: Egg Drop Soup
instructions: Bring stock and soy sauce to simmer. Stir in cornflour slurry to thicken slightly. Slowly pour beaten eggs while gently stirring. Garnish with green onions and sesame oil.

name: Cabbage & Mince Stir-Fry
instructions: Brown ground meat with minced garlic and ginger. Add shredded cabbage and carrots. Stir-fry for 5 minutes until vegetables are tender-crisp. Stir in soy sauce.

name: One-Pot Chicken & Rice
instructions: Brown chicken drumsticks in pot, remove. Sauté onion and garlic, add rice, paprika, stock, and peas. Return chicken on top, cover and simmer 20 minutes.

name: Spanish Rice & Beans
instructions: Sauté onion, garlic, bell pepper in oil. Add tomato paste, cumin, rice, beans, and stock. Cover and simmer 20 minutes until rice is fluffy.

name: Black Bean & Cheese Tacos
instructions: Sauté onion, garlic, beans, and cumin until warm. Warm corn tortillas. Fill with beans, top with grated cheese and salsa.

name: Cottage Pie
instructions: Sauté ground beef, onion, carrots, peas with stock until thick. Put in baking dish. Top with mashed potatoes. Bake at 200°C for 25 minutes.

name: Potato & Chickpea Massaman Curry
instructions: Simmer curry paste in coconut milk. Add diced potatoes, chickpeas, onion, and peanuts. Cook on medium heat for 20 minutes until potatoes are tender. Serve over rice.

name: Potato & Cheese Taquitos
instructions: Boil and mash potatoes with cumin and salt. Roll mashed potatoes and cheese in warm corn tortillas. Shallow fry until golden and crispy.

name: Baked Marinara Pasta
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic, add canned tomatoes and oregano, simmer 10 minutes. Toss cooked penne with sauce. Top with mozzarella and bake at 180°C for 20 minutes.

name: Creamy Potato & Leek Soup
instructions: Sauté onions and garlic in butter. Add peeled potatoes and vegetable stock. Simmer 20 minutes until tender. Blend until smooth, stir in milk, season well.

name: Upgraded Egg & Spinach Instant Ramen
instructions: Cook ramen in boiling water. Crack egg into broth and cover 2 minutes. Stir in spinach, soy sauce, and sesame oil. Top with green onions.

name: Microwave Mug Mac & Cheese
instructions: Microwave macaroni and water in a mug for 3 minutes. Stir in milk, butter, cheese, salt, and pepper. Microwave 1 more minute until cheesy.

name: 5-Minute Peanut Butter Sesame Noodles
instructions: Whisk peanut butter, soy sauce, garlic, warm water, and chili flakes into sauce. Toss with cooked hot noodles and green onions.

name: Tuna & Sweetcorn Salad Sandwich
instructions: Mix drained tuna and sweetcorn with mayonnaise and black pepper. Spread between bread slices for a quick protein lunch.

name: One-Pan Egg & Cheese Toastie
instructions: Whisk eggs, pour into buttered pan. Dip and place bread slices in egg. Flip when set. Fold egg edges over bread, add cheese, fold into sandwich and grill.

name: Microwave Loaded Potato
instructions: Poke holes in potato with a fork, microwave 7 minutes until tender. Slice open, mash inside with butter, cheese, yogurt, green onion, and salt.

name: Sheet Pan Chicken Drumsticks & Veggies
instructions: Toss drumsticks, chopped potatoes, and carrots with oil and spices on a baking tray. Bake at 200°C for 35 minutes.

name: Student Egg Fried Rice
instructions: Heat oil in pan. Scramble eggs, remove. Fry rice and frozen peas 3 minutes. Add soy sauce and eggs back in, toss and serve hot.

name: 3-Ingredient Banana Oat Pancakes
instructions: Mash banana, whisk with eggs, oats, and cinnamon. Fry spoonfuls in an oiled pan over medium heat for 2 minutes per side.

name: Microwave Scrambled Egg Mug
instructions: Whisk eggs, milk, butter, salt, and pepper in a mug. Microwave 45 seconds, stir. Microwave 30 seconds more. Sprinkle cheese on top.

name: One-Pot Taco Rice Bowl
instructions: Brown beef with taco seasoning. Add rice, 2 cups water, corn, beans, and salsa. Cover and simmer 15 minutes. Top with cheese.

name: Garlic Butter White Beans on Toast
instructions: Toast bread. Sauté minced garlic and drained white beans in butter for 3 minutes. Season with salt, pepper, parsley, and spoon over toast.

name: 5-Minute Cheesy Quesadilla
instructions: Spread cheese and salsa on half a tortilla, fold over. Fry in buttered pan 2 minutes per side until crispy and cheese is melted.

name: Quick Chickpea Salad Bowl
instructions: Drain and rinse chickpeas. Chop cucumber and tomatoes. Toss together in a bowl with olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.

name: Sweet Chili Chicken Wrap
instructions: Shred cooked chicken, mix with sweet chili sauce and mayo. Spread on tortilla with lettuce, roll tightly, and cut in half.
